info.title: Shelfline Field API
info.description:
The Shelfline Field API lets you sync stores, products and field teams with your own systems, plan visits and read the surveys collected in stores.

Shelfline is a fictional company: this API exists to demonstrate an OpenAPI clean-up pipeline and a multilingual docs portal.
